title: Food Market and Food Tour of Barcelona
text: Liliana was delightful and has great local knowledge of the Barcelona food experience. The market tour was excellent and we would recommend if your going to Barcelona book Liliana tour 🙏
author: Michael_S

title: The private tour with...
text: The private tour with Lusi was wonderful. Lusi not only introduced us to typical Spanish food, she gave shared so much information on the history of the Barcelona region. We throughly enjoyed our time and the personal attention was well worth the cost.
author: Vinita_W

title: Barcelona food tour

author: julieandersen

title: More than worth it.
text: Elvira was perfect very knowledgeable , friendly she knew her way around town took us to local markets and explained the true Catalon food and flavors and would definitely recommend. 10 stars is not enough for her or the amount of food you get. You better go hungry.
author: kevinmG2107DN

title: 10 Tasting With Locals- Alan is the best
text:
I am not one who usually does reviews, but because of reviews, I found Alan. 
Alan is the most incredible guide. He took us to 3 different markets where he introduced us to the various tastes of Barcelona. 
He went above and beyond! Knowledgeable and super personable. Not only learned about the local food but the culture and more. Great person all around!
Highly recommend!
author: michaelfO2074GP

title: Amazing Food Experience
text: Food tour @ The Markets. Silvina from Argentina was our tour guide. This was an Awesome experience. Visited 3 Markets (San Antoni, La Boquería, Santa Catalina). Food was amazing and host too!!!  Will do again and definitely recommend.
author: Nora_A

title: Definitely book with Gonzalo!!
text: I can't say enough good things about our tour with Gonzalo! He was so amazing that I sent my sister his info while we were on the tour because she's heading to Barcelona nextnweek. We booked the market tour with him and it was perfection! He shared a ton of history as we walked between tours and we also sampled some amazing local items. He clearly had a relationship with the vendors and they treated us all so kindly. I loved hearing the history of some of the food. title: Barcelona Tastes and Highlights
text: Alessandro gave us a lovely tour through Barcelona markets and the old town. His knowledge of the history was awesome and he explained it all in a very engaging way. It was great to taste some of the delights on offer and he was sure to take us to a couple of places that would be hard to find as a tourist in Barcelona. I would recommend Alessandro to anyone coming to Barcelona and looking for a walking tour.
author: Watskson

title: A brilliant tour
text: Alessandro gave us the perfect combination of history, architecture and food experience, all with a very personable manner. We would happily book more tours with him.
